evidence: Defining behaviour is graded directly: functional cw_basic_run_output, cw_html_preview, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work plus ~20 custom-editor criteria (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml). Server-backed state is a gate: constraints cw_shared_saved_record (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:27) saves a typed snippet, clears localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB/Cache/OPFS/service workers/cookies per app_context.md, reloads and requires exact title/filename/source, then a second reload - a localStorage-only app scores 0 overall. Durability across a true process restart: cw_save_reload_restart (functional judge.toml:339, weight 1.5) now requires two revisions with different sources, a storage-cleared reload re-read, the single-use restart_app tool (restart_mcp.py runs test.sh app-restart.sh which kills the process group and relaunches on the same DB_PATH), then a fresh page must show the same single record, current revision, history list, and the first revision's exact original source; reload/health is explicitly not accepted as restart evidence (functional prompt.md:33). This closes the earlier 'one snippet saved once' gap: an app that keeps only current rows in SQLite and history in memory, or an in-memory Map store (which passes the gate), now fails this criterion. Cross-context sharing is proven by cw_live_library_update and cw_stale_save_refused third-page reads; restore idempotence is checked by a fresh-page revision count. Brief support exists: behaviour.md requires snippets and history to survive a full server restart and a fresh page to read from the running app; integration.md requires SQLite, DB_PATH and persistence of ids/revisions. Golden server.js persists snippets, snippet_revisions and restore_operations in SQLite at DB_PATH. Conforming alternative: an app that shows revisions by timestamp rather than number can still satisfy 'same list of revisions' since display format of times is excused; no hidden requirement found. Nothing got looser for the model on this row: the restart check is strictly stronger than before and the gate is unchanged. Risk=true only because no runtime evidence exists for this candidate: raw-evidence-index.json is absent in qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick2, so the golden passing the restart re-read under the full configured judge (and restart tool success in the hosted verifier) is unmeasured.
